factions.name: House Shestendeliath (Kriv)
factions.objective: PLAYER-RUN power base, not a DM-run faction — listed only as a stance target and as an actor in react calls. Its moves are the party's decisions.

steps.text: Roskel completes the Gallowmere recruitment quota

reactions.alliance: Kriv answers in the open, with title and banner

factions.name: House Corr (Lady Sereth Corr)
factions.objective: Keep the Corr seat first among the three houses without paying for open war

steps.text: Sereth quietly buys the Chancellery succession clerk
Force a vote while Ilvane is still weak

reactions.alliance: Makes itself indispensable to the winning side before the losing side can beg
reactions.loss: Calls in an old debt in public, so the loss reads as a choice

factions.name: House Sablewood (Lord Berengar)
factions.objective: Profit from the succession whoever wins; owe nothing that cannot be sold

steps.text: Berengar brokers Compact mercenaries to Corr and Ilvane both

reactions.alliance: Prices it — offers the new bloc a service it cannot refuse at a rate that binds it
reactions.loss: Sells what it can no longer hold to whoever will owe for it

factions.name: House Ilvane (Lord Cassian)
factions.objective: Rebuild a house hollowed out by eight months of infiltration, and find who else was turned

operation.name: Purge and rebuild

steps.text: Elian Rook audits every servant hired in the last year
Cassian names Iskra a traitor before the Chancellery

operation.abandon_if: The audit points at Rook himself

reactions.alliance: Seeks the same patron rather than a rival one; Cassian no longer trusts his own counsel

factions.name: The Whisper Court (Iskra Vantrel)
factions.objective: Own the succession from behind every throne at once; never be seen doing it

operation.name: Survive the Ember Court

steps.text: Iskra and Sathriel finish reforming in the Ember Cradle
Buy back the Kesh Amara contract book before anyone reads it
Make the three houses pay for the ambush — every debt called in at once

operation.abandon_if: Both rakshasa are destroyed inside the Ember Court; the Court dies with them

reactions.alliance: Never confronts a new bloc head-on: buys or replaces one person inside it, then waits for the bloc to distrust itself
reactions.loss: Cuts the exposed limb off and denies it existed; the handler dies, not the agent

factions.name: Ashlord Concordat
factions.objective: Hold the ritual monopoly over legitimacy after Sarelle — and find out who is actually running Karsgate
assets: Karsgate garrison, held through Orell Tain's forged deputyship

operation.name: Verify Karsgate

steps.text: Emberhold chapter weighs Tain's internal-reform report
A ritualist is sent to Karsgate to see Kavash in person
If the seal cannot be vouched for, the deputyship is declared void

operation.abandon_if: Someone the chapter trusts vouches for Tain face to face

reactions.alliance: Declares the new bloc ritually illegitimate and starts the paperwork that makes it true
reactions.loss: Closes ranks around the archive, tightens escort protocol, suspects its own
reactions.exposure: Declares the appointment void, seals the archive, and sends its own people instead of asking again

factions.name: Ironclad Compact (Coren Ashvale)
factions.objective: Stay the indispensable third party to every war without being owned by any side
assets: Sethra Shestendeliath (Kriv's sister) inside the Compact

operation.name: The Table problem

steps.text: Coren tests which Table members would back a coup
Sethra brokers the Shestendeliath guarantee that makes the coup survivable

operation.abandon_if: Ilse Drummel moves against him first

reactions.alliance: Sells arms to whoever is now surrounded — the profit is always on the losing side
reactions.betrayal: Ends the contract without warning and collects on the bond

factions.name: The Kindled Circle (Odalys Ferrant)
factions.objective: Keep arcane practice in Emberhold licensed and answerable — and take custody of what the Concordat's ritual archive can no longer guard

operation.name: Claim the ash archive

steps.text: Petition the Chancellery for custody of the Concordat's unguarded ritual holdings
Send two adepts to inventory what Ashvale left behind

operation.abandon_if: The Concordat produces a leader the Chancellery will recognise

reactions.alliance: Licenses the winner and taxes the practice; legitimacy is the Circle's product

factions.name: Karsgate Undertow (Doss / Iron Sella Dray)
factions.objective: Keep the underside of Karsgate theirs while the surface tears itself apart

steps.text: Doss sends a collector to Harrowgate for the first payment

reactions.alliance: Raises the tariff under the city on the side that just gained

factions.name: The Unfinished Circle (Sylandra Cael)
factions.objective: Complete a three-hundred-year-old immortality that was finished wrong

steps.text: Sylandra tests the volunteered-power principle on a subject

reactions.other: Cares only for the research; trades knowledge to whoever removes an obstacle

factions.name: The Cinder Choir
factions.objective: Feed the Hollow Prophet's furnace; the chain above the destroyed Gallowmere cell is still intact

factions.name: House Varn ("Lord Dorian Varn" / D.V. — rakshasa)
factions.objective: Inherit the Ashen Crown's power at the moment it is made whole — never by his own hand, always through someone else's
assets: A century-old mask and the Varn name
whatever is left of Draven Holt's and Sarelle's networks

operation.name: The collector's patience

steps.text: Learn how many fragments the party actually holds — through the debt, never by asking
Call in the unnamed debt at the moment refusing it would cost the party most
Be present, unseen, when the last fragment is set (arc 3a)

operation.abandon_if: The party proves able to hold the Crown's power themselves — then he moves to replace them, not to inherit from them

reactions.gain: Never contests a gain; invests further in whoever is winning and positions to inherit it
reactions.exposure: The mask IS the power. He kills to keep it, and he does not warn first
reactions.death: Notes which tool broke and reaches for the next one; he has never mourned an instrument

factions.name: The Chancellery (Chancellor Maro Veskin)
factions.objective: Keep the three houses balanced so that authority runs through the seat — no house may win outright

operation.name: Keep the gap open

steps.text: Replace Ostwin Kade with a clerk he can trust — and find out how Kade died
Quietly restore Ilvane's standing so no single bloc dominates
Set the next succession hearing for a date that suits the weakest claim

operation.abandon_if: One house secures an advantage the Chancellery can no longer reverse

reactions.alliance: Answers any bloc by elevating its weakest rival; the seat's power is the gap between the houses
reactions.loss: Slows the calendar — a hearing postponed is a decision unmade
